title: SCOUT: Sim-to-Real Text-Based Person Retrieval by Embedding-Space Prediction over Frozen Video Features
abstract: arXiv:2609.19483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-based person retrieval under a sim-to-real gap (synthetic training data, a real-image gallery) is usually tackled with costly fine-tuned cross-encoders. We ask whether a frozen-encoder system can compete. We present SCOUT, which casts cross-modal retrieval as prediction in embedding space. A trainable predictor maps the patch tokens of a frozen video encoder into the embedding space of a frozen text encoder under a bidirectional InfoNCE objective, and no encoder is fine-tuned in the base model. The video encoder is V-JEPA, the text encoder is EmbeddingGemma, and the predictor is initialized from a Qwen3.5-0.8B decoder. We make three findings. First, the best frozen text encoder is simply the one whose geometry best matches the video features. translated_title: SCOUT：基于冻结视频特征的嵌入空间预测实现从仿真到真实的文本行人检索
translated_abstract: 在存在从仿真到真实差距（即使用合成训练数据、真实图像库进行检索）的场景下，基于文本的行人检索通常需要代价高昂的微调交叉编码器来解决。我们探究冻结编码器系统能否与之竞争。我们提出SCOUT，它将跨模态检索转化为嵌入空间中的预测问题。一个可训练的预测器在双向InfoNCE目标函数下，将冻结视频编码器的图像块标记（patch tokens）映射到冻结文本编码器的嵌入空间中，基础模型中没有任何编码器被微调。视频编码器采用V-JEPA，文本编码器采用EmbeddingGemma，预测器由Qwen3.5-0.8B解码器初始化。我们得出三个发现。第一，最佳的冻结文本编码器就是其特征几何结构最能与视频特征匹配的那一个。一个免训练的对齐分数对三个候选文本编码器的排序与它们在我们保留验证集上的检索精度排序完全一致（Spearman ρ = 1.0）；第四个基于LLM的编码器……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SCOUT无需微调任何编码器，仅通过训练一个预测器将冻结的V-JEPA视频特征映射到冻结文本编码器的嵌入空间，以双向InfoNCE目标实现从仿真到真实的文本行人检索，并发现文本编码器与视频特征的几何对齐程度可免训练地预测其检索性能。
en_tdlr: SCOUT achieves sim-to-real text-based person retrieval without fine-tuning any encoder by training only a predictor that maps frozen V-JEPA video features into a frozen text encoder's embedding space under bidirectional InfoNCE, and shows that the geometric alignment between text and video features can predict retrieval performance without training.
